physicalBoundaryProbe.method: Navigate to170,3,0 then actual Humanoid MoveTo195,3,0; observe after2seconds

subjectiveObservations: Both shelter doorways and colored west/east lanes were readable at the observed viewport; the gold launcher marker joins the two routes.

Actual R15 avatar walked both approaches without jumping, destruction or ammunition. Recorded avatar/accessory visual extents differ from the automated4x6x4-stud clearance fixture; this does not prove every possible avatar fits.
The orange24-stud boundary is visually distinct and physically stopped walking; server correction returned a deliberately outside actual character to the protected anchor.

Four cardinal perimeter views at altitude140studs, focused on map center, showed clear open firing lanes and stable shelter/ruin silhouettes. Eight-phase ray assertions are the automated sight-line evidence.

resolvedDefects.description: Position/Orientation aliases serialized but did not load as intended transforms; map stacked at origin and bootstrap rejected startup.
resolvedDefects.resolution: Canonical CFrame assets and artifact reconstruction gate; loaded disk/spawn transforms correct and all final engine cases pass.

limitations: One actual Studio client per fresh Play session; no multiplayer/combat/capacity/performance claim.
No separate release-document Play run; release reconstruction and isolation checked by host gate.
No aircraft, thermal camera, combat, launcher pickup, destruction or rounds in P02; perimeter positions are canonical future orbit samples.
Original cloud place and prior broken document untouched; final corrected local test document stopped in Edit.
redactions: Client userId omitted from client reports; counts and other test fields unchanged.
